prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel, extending onto the rear door and bumper cover, with a cracked tail lamp housing and scuffed paint consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described. Repairs call for panel straightening, replacement of the bumper cover and lamp assembly, and refinishing of the affected panels. The labor hours on the estimate fit the scope of this damage, and the parts and invoices submitted contain no repeated charges. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle.
